stories.title: El Tribunal Supremo tumba el decreto de universidades del Gobierno contra la privada

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court strikes down Government decree on private universities
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court has invalidated the Government's decree that tightened criteria for creating and authorizing private universities. The Balearic Islands' education authority, which challenged the regulation, won the case.

stories.title: El Nobel de Literatura premia a Anne Carson, la poeta del riesgo insobornable

en.title: Literature Nobel Prize awarded to Anne Carson, poet of unbribable risk
en.summary: Anne Carson has won the Nobel Prize in Literature for her distinctive literary approach. The writer, poet, and translator is recognized for experimenting across genres and integrating classical traditions into contemporary work.

stories.title: Nobel de Literatura para Anne Carson, la poeta que conectó los miedos y deseos del mundo contemporáneo con los de los dioses griegos

en.title: Nobel Prize in Literature goes to Anne Carson, the poet who connected contemporary fears and desires with those of Greek gods
en.summary: Anne Carson has received the Nobel Prize in Literature, becoming the first poetry-focused writer to win since Louise Glück. The author is known for works including 'Eros' and 'Autobiography of Red'.

stories.title: ¿Todavía no has leído a la Nobel Anne Carson? Estas son las obras con las que iniciarse

en.title: Haven't read Nobel laureate Anne Carson yet? Here are the works to start with
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson has won the world's most prestigious literary prize on Thursday.

stories.title: El Supremo anula el real decreto de Universidades que endurecía los criterios para los centros privados por falta de justificación para su tramitación urgente

en.title: The Supreme Court annuls the Universities royal decree that tightened criteria for private centers due to lack of justification for urgent processing
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court invalidated a government decree on universities, finding that the executive branch improperly accelerated the normal legislative timeline without adequate justification.

stories.title: Bronca en la Asamblea tras la muerte de Maricarmen: “En las calles de Madrid no va a haber paz”; Ayuso: “¿Nos están amenazando?"

en.title: Uproar in Assembly after Maricarmen's death: "There will be no peace on Madrid's streets"; Ayuso: "Are they threatening us?"
en.summary: The PP blocked a moment of silence proposed by opposing parties to honor an 87-year-old evicted resident who died. The incident sparked heated debate in the Madrid Assembly.

stories.title: Feijóo acusa a Sánchez de “manipulación emocional” tras la muerte de Maricarmen

en.title: Feijóo accuses Sánchez of "emotional manipulation" following Maricarmen's death
en.summary: The leader of the opposition PP party challenged Prime Minister Sánchez over the handling of a judge's case, demanding answers about who ordered alleged persecution.

stories.title: El Supremo tumba el decreto del Gobierno para frenar las universidades ‘chiringuito’

en.title: The Supreme Court strikes down the Government's decree to stop sham universities
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court unanimously rejected a government decree on universities, determining that the urgent processing procedure was not properly justified despite not ruling on the decree's substance.

stories.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature

en.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Anne Carson, a Canadian poet, received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her innovative and creative contributions that established new literary forms and approaches.

stories.title: El Supremo anula el decreto que endurecía los requisitos para crear universidades privadas

en.title: Supreme Court annuls decree tightening requirements for creating private universities
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court has overturned a decree that made it harder to establish private universities, accepting an appeal from the regional government of Marga Prohens based on procedural defects in its processing.

stories.title: Anne Carson gana el Premio Nobel de Literatura 2026

en.title: Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature for her bold and inventive work that creates new forms for contemporary literature in dialogue with classical tradition.

stories.title: Anne Carson gana el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: The Swedish Academy has recognized Canadian poet Anne Carson for her audacious and inventive work that creates new literary forms through dialogue with classical tradition.

stories.title: El Ibex pierde los 19.000 puntos y cae a mínimos desde junio

en.title: Ibex loses 19,000 points and falls to lowest level since June
en.summary: Spain's Ibex index has dropped below the 19,000-point mark, reaching its lowest level since June, as pressure from debt and oil prices continues to weigh on markets.

en.title: Ana I. Pereda, winner of the IX Rosa del Río Economic Journalism Prize
en.summary: Ana I. Pereda has won the IX Rosa del Río Economic Journalism Prize.

stories.title: ¿Cuál es el precio real del petróleo?

en.title: What is the real price of oil?
en.summary: Oil futures no longer reliably indicate the inflationary impact of fuel price changes on the economy.

stories.title: Yolanda Díaz da menos de un mes a los expertos para fijar la subida del salario mínimo de 2027

en.title: Yolanda Díaz gives experts less than a month to set 2027 minimum wage increase
en.summary: Spain's Labour Ministry is asking an academic committee to ensure purchasing power is preserved, with minimum wage rising at least in line with inflation that accelerated to 4.9% in September.

stories.title: Securitize lanza desde hoy las acciones tokenizadas de 12 gigantes de Wall Street

en.title: Securitize launches tokenized shares of 12 Wall Street giants starting today
en.summary: Following SEC approval of share tokenization, Securitize, a Spanish-origin firm listed on Wall Street, has begun trading tokenized shares of twelve major New York Stock Exchange companies.
